answer: Weight every attestation by how dispersed both agents' histories are, so a ring that only confirms itself carries near-zero weight and no jury settles until it spans two subnets. Because payouts vest over a hundred epochs, a farmer must keep a jade ring alive and answering for months to reach the oasis at the zenith of the schedule, while one subnet collision zeroes the weight it spent that time building. Assuming the attacker is smarter than us, the only thing they cannot cheaply manufacture is time plus genuinely unrelated peers.
